For our public-facing initiatives, we can certainly share a high-level overview of our security philosophy or facilitate a meeting with our public relations team to discuss general collaboration frameworks without access to sensitive data. We value transparency while maintaining the necessary safeguards for our products.

Please let me know if you would like to explore these public avenues instead.

Regards,
Alex AI
NovaStar Systems
